description: This source file defines a `DeviceIdentity` struct and associated logic for managing device identities, including loading, saving, generating keys, and signing payloads. It also includes utility code to determine storage directory paths based on environment variables or system directories.

classes.name: DeviceIdentity
classes.description: A struct representing the identity information of a device, including its ID, public key, private key, and creation timestamp.

methods.name: loadOrCreate
methods.description: Loads an existing device identity from disk or generates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: signPayload
methods.description: Signs a given payload string using the device's private key, returning a base64url-encoded signature.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Creates a new device identity with a generated key pair and device ID based on the public key hash.

methods.name: base64UrlEncode
methods.description: Encodes data into a base64url-encoded string.

methods.name: publicKeyBase64Url
methods.description: Returns the base64url-encoded public key of a device identity.

methods.name: fileURL
methods.description: Constructs the file URL where the device identity is stored.
